_doc: H2 known-defect ledger for scripts/db-proof/tbHandlerCharacterization.mjs (blueprint Revision 2 defect ledger).
Each signature is the EXACT value the deployed-equivalent handler (process-trial-balance at main af8a96b) produces for the probe's fixture, recorded from a real-handler, real-PostgreSQL run.

A probe counts as 'defect reproduced' (never a pass) only when the observed value equals this signature AND differs from the probe's independent oracle (bigint minor units, class-side table, computed in the test).
Matching the oracle means the defect was fixed: the fixing PR (E1) must remove the entry. Any other value fails the gate.

defects.assertion: cash total of three reviewed cash accounts equals their sum (file order 10,000.00 / 20,000.00 / 30,500.00)
cash total is independent of row order (reversed order)
no cash reconciliation is claimed (nothing independent was compared): cash_reconciliation is null
a reviewed current-asset credit named 'Closing stock' stays a (negative) current asset as mapped; nothing is moved into cost of goods sold
liabilities are summed class-side (credit positive) whatever the mapping's normal_balance; the equation difference is 0
an authoritative certification never carries a BALANCE_SHEET_EQUATION_FAILED exception (for this fixture the correct engine has no failure)
a non-reporting decision cannot remove a non-zero balance: the upload needs review and nothing is authoritative
an equation-failure message states the difference at the currency's exponent (BHD: 3 decimals)
